scope_basis.quote: I think a lot of the times we just kind of run regression tests and say that two are the same. That's kind of how I feel. I'm trying to prevent something like that.

requested_result: Improve comparative evaluation beyond regression passes, test sensitivity and preserve honest tradeoffs and uncertainty.

required_checks.description: Comparison differentiates meaningful task-specific advantages among acceptable real outputs while admitting scoped equality or missing priorities.
Actual qualified baseline/revised measurements and affected decision handoff executed.
Correctness gates, missingness, no-forced-winner and maintenance paths preserved.
